title: Foundation model
extract: In artificial intelligence, a foundation model (FM), also known as large x model, is a machine learning or deep learning model trained on vast datasets so that it can be applied across a wide range of use cases. Generative AI applications like large language models (LLMs) are common examples of foundation models.
